jobs.title: Full Stack Web Development Intern
jobs.description:
Full Stack Web Development Internship

Location:
Remote (India)
Type:
Part-time Internship (~5-15 hours/week)
Duration:
3-6 months
Stipend:
Performance-based compensation, to be paid at the end of the internship
Start Date:
Immediate
Possibility of converting to full-time role based on performance

About Deckoviz

Deckoviz Space Labs is a next-gen AI-powered Smart Art Portal and creative studio reimagining how we interact with space, memory, mood, and meaning. We combine design, deep personalization, and generative AI to transform screens into evolving art and storytelling experiences. At the core of Deckoviz is a commitment to building magical, beautiful, and expressive products that live in people’s most sacred spaces.

About the Internship

We’re looking for a talented Full Stack Web Development Intern
to join us. This is a part-time, high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who’s excited to work on products that merge AI, design, and human emotion.
You’ll be working directly with our core team to prototype, build, and refine websites, internal and external web tools, dashboards, micro-sites, and creative experiments that power the Deckoviz ecosystem.

Who You Are

You're looking specifically
for an internship.
You’re available to work 5–20 hours/week remotely.
You have solid hands-on experience across multiple JavaScript frameworks
- React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar.
You have strong fundamentals in Python, Django, FastAPI, or other backend tech.
You have basic knowledge of deployment, servers, and cloud.
You have a good sense of design
, UX
, and frontend polish.
You know how to build, debug, and deploy web applications quickly.
You’re a self-starter
, excited by the creative process, and comfortable with ambiguity.
Double bonus if you’ve built portfolio projects, creative web experiences, or contributed to open source.

What You’ll Work On

Building web-based interfaces and web-apps for content management, art configuration, or internal tools
Prototyping experimental features and user experiences for the Deckoviz platform
Collaborating with designers, product thinkers, and AI engineers
Writing clean, modular, and reusable code
Working in a rapid feedback loop with real users and real devices

What You’ll Gain

The opportunity to work on early-stage creative-tech products from the inside
Mentorship from experienced product and design leaders
Exposure to generative AI tools, hardware+software integration, and fast prototyping cycles
A potential full-time offer
post-internship based on performance
A creative environment that rewards initiative, ideas, and design sensibility
A stipend at the end of the internship period
Certificate of Completion of Internship
